name: openclaw-plugin-whatsapp-call-contact
description: OpenClaw tool plugin that lets one authorized WhatsApp sender call pre-approved WhatsApp contacts via MeowCaller and ElevenLabs.

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run plugin:build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
